name: Hostess Bakery - Columbus GA

fieldNotes.truckGate: Property has a confirmed chain-link perimeter fence (visible in 2024-12 Street View along the E side). The truck driveway necessarily passes through a fence opening = a controlled pinch-point, so truckGate set true. No barrier arm directly resolved in imagery - medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed guard booth observed at the truck driveway or any entrance. The small blue-roof structure in the NE yard is an ancillary building, not a gate booth.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: Fenced perimeter + controlled truck drive but no guard booth implies kiosk / call-box / app check-in - set true; flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.preGateStaging: Trucks observed parked along the public E perimeter-road curb (Swift, Denson Freight tractors) - de facto pre-gate staging on the street.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: Trucks staging on the public curb indicates limited on-street stacking; a queue could spill along the perimeter road - flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Large trailer drop yard on the NE/E side, packed with 50+ trailers in rows.
fieldNotes.dockDoorCount: Estimate ~35 doors along the SE building face with trailers backed in - overhead estimate.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Inside Columbus GA metro along the Victory Drive arterial corridor - Urban.
fieldNotes.method: Active $120M Smucker expansion underway (completing early 2027); rooftop construction activity visible in satellite imagery.
